title: 花旗缩短晋升年限：初级银行家两年升经理，议价能力却已回落？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: City is cutting the time. It's investment banking analysts need to wait to advance to associate level to two years from three years
segments.zh: 花旗正在缩短时间，其投行分析师晋升到副总裁级别需要等待的时间从三年减少到两年。

segments.en: It's part of the bank's push to attract and retain top talent in a fierce job market joining us now It's been a chief Wall Street correspondent street art non-derage on is the job market still that fierce
segments.zh: 这是该行在激烈的就业市场中吸引和留住顶尖人才的努力的一部分。现在加入我们的是华尔街首席记者，市场就业还那么激烈吗？

segments.en: I thought this was like a COVID thing that it was hard to get workers What what's still happening in the labor market among the bankers that they'd make this change?
segments.zh: 我以为这是像疫情时期那样，很难找到工人。在银行家当中，劳动力市场还在发生什么，以至于他们要做出这种改变？

segments.en: I'm glad you also a question because that that's the first question I had in mind when I read the story because if this was a headline that appeared in 2021 early 2022
segments.zh: 我很高兴你也问这个问题，因为这是我读到这个故事时首先想到的问题，因为如果这是2021年初或2022年初的头条新闻，

segments.en: You could understand it that was the moment when junior bankers had most way they had the most leverage things seem to have turned Of course, if you go back to last year there was a lot of consternation and conversation about this
segments.zh: 你可以理解，那是初级银行家最有优势的时候，他们拥有最大的议价能力。情况似乎已经转变。当然，如果你回到去年，有很多关于这个的焦虑和讨论。

segments.en: push and pull between private equity firms and banks Jamie Dimon leaf Jamie Dimon famously came out and gave one of his furious runs where he said it's unethical
segments.zh: 私募股权公司和银行之间的拉锯战。杰米·戴蒙，杰米·戴蒙曾 famously 发表过一次愤怒的言论，他说这是不道德的。

segments.en: Unacceptable for junior bankers who were just getting into their seats to already be accepting a job elsewhere Which is finding the next job in private equity because according to him what they were doing was
segments.zh: 对于刚入职的初级银行家来说，已经接受其他工作是不可接受的，也就是在私募股权找到下一份工作，因为据他说，他们所做的是

segments.en: Not right they were dealing with a lot of confidential information and JP Morgan also tried to do some of it tried to speed up the amount of time that analysts have to spend as analysts before they get that a-to-a promotion before they become associates and
segments.zh: 不对的，他们处理大量机密信息。摩根大通也尝试做了一些，试图加快分析师在晋升为副总裁之前必须担任分析师的时间。

segments.en: City now has come out and done the same thing moving their analyst program from a three-year program to a to a two-year program ostensibly to fend off private equity but to go back to your original question the timing just it just doesn't feel the same way
segments.zh: 花旗现在也出来做了同样的事情，将其分析师项目从三年制改为两年制，表面上是为了抵御私募股权，但回到你最初的问题，时机感觉就是不一样。
